full_description: A table-tennis ball rolls off a wall shelf onto the table and toward an edge; use the matching hand to stop it so it stays on the table (a touch that then falls off still fails).
schema: {A} notifies the ball, {B} notifies the shelf, {a} notifies the arm used
preference: num of words should not exceed 14. Degree of detail avg is 6
seen: Stop {A} before it falls off the table
Block the ball before the edge
Stop {A} from falling off the table
Intercept {A} and keep it on the table
unseen: Stop the rolling ball with {a} before it falls off
Halt {A} on the table before the near edge
